name: cc-orchestrador-subagents
description: Multi-agent development orchestrator for Claude Code that runs from an existing PRD/spec. Ingests the user-provided specification as source of truth, then coordinates Codex back-end and Antigravity/AGY front-end subagents in parallel (including native Gemini subagent fan-out via --agy-parallel/--agy-subagent-model), runs Codex back-end review and AGY (gemini-3.1-pro-high) front-end review, supports autonomous /goal execution, then produces consolidated subagent context, an implementation report and business-level user instructions.
